# AMEVA-MCP-Hub (v3.0.0)
> Zero-Install Universal Polyglot WASM & AI Vector Model Context Protocol Hub

## Quick Specification for AI Coding Agents
- Official Repo: https://github.com/uno-km/ameva-mcp-hub
- Installation: `npx ameva-mcp-hub
# or as SDK:
npm install ameva-mcp-hub`
- Architecture: Executes multi-language open-source tools (C++, Rust, Java, Python, Go) in-memory via WASI WebAssembly inside a single Node.js process with dynamic multi-repo subscriptions, real-time AI tool propagation, and heuristic route dispatching.

## Canonical Code Pattern
```python
# Connect Claude Desktop / Cursor via npx:
# { "mcpServers": { "hub": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "ameva-mcp-hub"] } } }

```

## Key Constraints
- Pure non-blocking architecture, zero memory leaks.
- Strictly adhere to closed-form precision and WebGPU/Bionic ARM64 native targets.
